task_title: Floor 2 Slice 3 — family-aware AI, hate ramp, feud targeting, ally defend

plan_review.notes: Concerns identified during planning: (1) Slice 1 API rename effectiveSpeedForHate must be honored — used correctly; (2) rival-detection MUST use spatial hash not O(n²) — new SpatialHashGrid built per-frame, feudCandidateLimit trims candidate list before sort; (3) friendly retaliation MUST reuse the existing hit signal not add a parallel bus — reused the applyDamage choke point (see code_review round 2 for the durable-signal correction); (4) both simulation pipelines (headless src/game/ai and visual src/bootstrap/floor-main-scene-options) must wire the new system — done; (5) hate-band mobs already faster than the player must be unaffected — effectiveSpeedForHate returns baseSpeed in that case and getEnemySpeed composes status slows on top of the ramped base. Design: chose a prepass system stamping decisions into a map consumed by enemyAISystem (over inlining into the ~1810-line enemyAISystem loop) to limit regression surface and give tests + the lab overlay a stable observable via getFamilyAIDecision().

rounds.notes: Round 1 (original authoring): (1) queryRadius returns a REUSED buffer — added explicit .slice(0, limit) before iteration; (2) retaliation state needed to not re-arm on replay — handled via a per-world cursor at the time (later superseded by the durable world.lastPlayerHit signal in round 2).

PR-shepherd pass over the 6 copilot-pull-request-reviewer threads. TWO were REAL runtime bugs: (1) ally-defend never fired in the visual game because familyFeudSystem (preSystems) read the transient world.combatEvents queue, which combatVfx.update drains to length 0 every rendered frame (CombatVfx.ts:98 via MainGameScene.ts) — so the hit event from frame N was gone before the feud read it in frame N+1; headless masked this because it never drains combatEvents. Fixed with a durable world.lastPlayerHit signal set at the applyDamage choke point (survives the drain; single code path across both pipelines) and added a deterministic drain test (tests/ecs/enemyAISystem.ally-defend.test.ts) that reproduces the real frame-loop drain and asserts ally-defend still fires. (2) enemy projectiles never attached Owner, so retaliation recorded the transient projectile eid (destroyed on impact) as the attacker — threaded ownerEid through spawnEnemyProjectile so the firing enemy is recorded; test asserts lastPlayerHit.attackerEid === shooter. FOUR consistency/doc fixes: slow-precedence in getEnemySpeed (ramp folded into base, then status slows composed on top so a slowed hate mob stays slowed); rival-fallback made reachable for ramped hate mobs (dropped the familyDecision===undefined guard, safe because !familyBypass already implies bypassPlayerDetection:false); corrected the familyFeudSystem tie-break docstring (lower-eid, not rng) and the band-targeting test docstring (prepass-scoped) — the latter also strengthened with a real prepass→enemyAISystem→movementSystem end-to-end test.
